1: ## 1. Crate scaffolding
2: 
3: - [x] 1.1 Create `tls-client/` crate at workspace Layer 1; register in `Cargo.toml` (workspace 27 → 28); confirm `#![no_std]` + `extern crate alloc`
4: - [x] 1.2 Add `smallaios-security` and `smallaios-kernel` (for `kernel::clock()` access) as dependencies
5: - [ ] 1.3 Add `smallaios-tls-client = { path = "../tls-client", optional = true }` to `container/Cargo.toml`; extend the existing `audit-export` feature to enable it *(deferred to Phase 8 integration)*
6: - [x] 1.4 Update CLAUDE.md workspace architecture diagram (27 → 28 crates; `tls-client` under Layer 1)
7: - [x] 1.5 Add `tls-client` to `Justfile` `host_crates` list and DSM allow-list
8: - [x] 1.6 Cyclic-dep check passes; clippy `-D warnings` clean on empty crate
9: 
10: ## 2. `security::crypto::chacha20_poly1305`
11: 
12: - [x] 2.1 Add `security/src/crypto/chacha20.rs` with the IETF ChaCha20 stream cipher (RFC 8439 § 2.4)
13: - [x] 2.2 Add `security/src/crypto/poly1305.rs` with the Poly1305 one-time MAC (RFC 8439 § 2.5)
14: - [x] 2.3 Compose into `security/src/crypto/chacha20_poly1305.rs` providing `seal` / `open` (matches the existing `aes_gcm` shape; constant-time tag compare via inline accumulator)
15: - [x] 2.4 NIST + RFC 8439 KAT tests (≥4 vectors) including the canonical RFC 8439 § 2.8 example *(11 tests pass: § 2.3.2, § 2.4.2, § 2.5.2, § 2.8.2 + tamper-rejection variants + empty round-trips)*
16: - [ ] 2.5 `cargo-fuzz` target on `Aead::open` against arbitrary bytes *(deferred — added with the rest of the tls-client fuzz targets in Phase 10)*
17: 
18: ## 3. Record layer
19: 
20: - [x] 3.1 `tls-client/src/record.rs` — `ContentType`, `TLSPlaintext`, `TLSCiphertext` encoders + decoders
21: - [x] 3.2 Enforce `TLSPlaintext.length ≤ 2^14` and `TLSCiphertext.length ≤ 2^14 + 256` BEFORE allocation
22: - [x] 3.3 Refuse `LegacyVersion` outside `{0x0303}` (post-handshake)
23: - [x] 3.4 AEAD wrap/unwrap routing on cipher-suite negotiation *(two suites: AES-256-GCM-SHA384 and ChaCha20-Poly1305-SHA256; AES-128-GCM deferred per design.md D2)*
24: - [x] 3.5 Unit tests: round-trip for each of the three suites; oversized rejection; legacy-version rejection *(16 tests: header round-trip, header too short, unknown content type, oversized length, legacy-version enforcement, cipher-suite wire round-trip + AES-128 refused, per-record nonce XOR, plaintext record round-trip + oversized, seal/open round-trip for both suites, tampered ciphertext, wrong seq, legacy-version mismatch, ciphertext too short, wrong outer content type)*
25: - [ ] 3.6 `cargo-fuzz` target on the inbound record parser *(deferred — added with the other tls-client fuzz targets in Phase 10)*
26: 
27: ## 4. Handshake state machine
28: 
29: - [x] 4.1 `tls-client/src/handshake/` — message types: HandshakeType (ClientHello/ServerHello/EncryptedExtensions/Certificate/CertificateRequest/CertificateVerify/Finished/NewSessionTicket/KeyUpdate); 4-byte HandshakeHeader (type + 24-bit length); extension encoders/parsers for supported_versions, supported_groups, signature_algorithms, key_share, server_name
30: - [x] 4.2 Build ClientHello: legacy_version=0x0303, supported_versions=[0x0304], supported_groups configurable (PQC hybrid first when `require_pqc`), key_share matching primary supported_group, signature_algorithms allow-list per spec, server_name when DNS endpoint
31: - [x] 4.3 Parse ServerHello: pin `supported_versions = 0x0304`; pin `legacy_version = 0x0303`; pin `legacy_compression_method = 0`; refuse unsupported cipher_suite; surface (cipher_suite, group, public_key, selected_version)
32: - [ ] 4.4 Derive handshake-traffic keys via `net::quic::tls::TlsKeySchedule::derive_handshake_secrets` *(state-machine driver — follow-on commit; the message layer it consumes is ready)*
33: - [ ] 4.5 Parse EncryptedExtensions; check SNI ack *(state-machine driver follow-on)*
34: - [ ] 4.6 Parse Certificate; pass each cert to the cert-chain verifier *(needs Phase 5)*
35: - [ ] 4.7 Parse CertificateVerify; verify signature against the leaf's pubkey + transcript hash; enforce the signature-suite allow-list *(needs Phase 5)*
36: - [ ] 4.8 Parse server Finished; verify HMAC over transcript *(state-machine driver follow-on)*
37: - [ ] 4.9 Send client Finished; derive application-traffic keys; transition to data phase *(state-machine driver follow-on)*
38: - [x] 4.10 Unit tests for the message layer: ServerHello selecting TLS 1.2 → `Version` error; missing supported_versions → `Version`; unsupported cipher_suite → `BadHandshake`; non-zero compression method → reject; wrong legacy_version → `Version`; truncated → reject. (PqcDowngrade and SHA-1 CertificateVerify cases land with their respective phases.)
39: 
40: ## 5. X.509v3 parser + chain verifier
41: 
42: - [x] 5.1 `tls-client/src/cert/der.rs` — minimal DER TLV decoder. Accepts short-form length (≤127), long-form length (1-4 octets, value ≤ 1 MiB cap); refuses indefinite-length, multi-byte tag forms, non-minimal long forms, length exceeding enclosing structure
43: - [x] 5.3 Length-bound every OCTET STRING / SEQUENCE before allocation *(landed with 5.1)*
44: - [x] 5.7 RFC 6125 hostname matcher (`tls-client/src/cert/hostname.rs`): DNS-ID with exact + wildcard matching (leftmost-label, ≥3-label cert, no mid-label `*`, no multi-label span); iPAddress SAN (IPv4 + IPv6 with `::` elision); refuses DNS-ID for IP literals and vice versa
45: - [ ] 5.2 Refuse `version != v3`, SHA-1 signatures, missing SAN *(follow-on: full X.509v3 structure parser — needs RSA-PSS + ECDSA-P256 primitives in security/, both deferred)*
46: - [ ] 5.4 Chain construction: leaf → intermediate(s) → anchor in trust store; each intermediate must have `BasicConstraints.CA = true` + `KeyUsage.keyCertSign` *(follow-on)*
47: - [ ] 5.5 Signature verification on every link (Ed25519, ECDSA-P256, RSA-PSS) *(follow-on; Ed25519 ready in security/crypto/ed25519; ECDSA-P256 and RSA-PSS deferred to their own primitive sub-adds)*
48: - [ ] 5.6 Validity-window check with `kernel::clock()`; unsynced-clock sentinel handling; audit `audit_export_unsynced_clock` on bypass *(follow-on)*
49: - [ ] 5.8 Cross-vector tests in `tls-client/tests/corpus/`: ≥10 known-good cert chains + ≥6 known-bad *(follow-on; requires the full structure parser + a synthetic Ed25519-signed cert generator harness)*
50: - [ ] 5.9 `cargo-fuzz` target on the X.509 parser *(follow-on; the DER decoder landed in this commit is the largest attacker-controlled surface and is fuzz-ready)*
51: 
52: ## 6. Trust store
53: 
54: - [ ] 6.1 `tls-client/src/trust.rs` — PEM bundle loader (base64-decode each `BEGIN CERTIFICATE` / `END CERTIFICATE` block)
55: - [ ] 6.2 Reject empty bundles, non-CA certs, duplicate Subjects
56: - [ ] 6.3 Optional pin verification: when `tls.trust_store_pin` is set, refuse chains anchored elsewhere
57: - [ ] 6.4 Wire `Config::validate` in `audit-export::config` to enforce: `enabled = true && trust_store_path = ""` → `ConfigError::TrustStoreRequired`
58: - [ ] 6.5 Tests: empty bundle, non-CA cert, duplicate Subjects, valid bundle, pinned vs non-pinned chain accept/reject
59: 
60: ## 7. `std`-IO adapter (`TcpTlsStream`)
61: 
62: - [ ] 7.1 `tls-client/src/std_io/mod.rs` — `TcpTlsStream` wrapping `std::net::TcpStream`
63: - [ ] 7.2 `TcpTlsStream::connect(host, port, config) -> Result<Self, TlsClientError>` — drives the handshake state machine over the TCP socket
64: - [ ] 7.3 Implement `Read`, `Write`, and the existing `container::audit_export_runtime::transport::TlsStreamLike` trait (with `close()` sending `close_notify`)
65: - [ ] 7.4 Map `TlsClientError` → `TransportError`: TcpConnect / Io / BadHandshake → `Retry`; everything else → `HardFail`
66: - [ ] 7.5 Unit tests with a `Vec<u8>`-backed mock socket exercising the handshake state machine end-to-end
67: - [ ] 7.6 `tls-client/tests/e2e.rs` — `#[ignore]`-gated test against `TLS_E2E_URL` (real https endpoint) when the env var is set
68: 
69: ## 8. `audit-export` integration
70: 
71: - [ ] 8.1 In `container/src/audit_export_runtime/`, replace the `TlsStreamLike` placeholder docs with a pointer to `tls_client::std_io::TcpTlsStream`
72: - [ ] 8.2 Add a `connect_immudb(config: &Config) -> Result<TcpTlsStream, TransportError>` helper that bridges `Config::endpoint` + `Config::server_pubkey_fingerprint` + `Config::trust_store_path` into the TLS client
73: - [ ] 8.3 Update the `audit_export_runtime::transport` tests: at least one test that drives a full handshake against a `MockServer` exposing canned TLS records
74: - [ ] 8.4 Confirm the existing `audit-export-immudb-client` scenarios ("TLS 1.2 handshake rejected", "PQC hybrid offered first", "HTTP/2 server push refused") now pass end-to-end
75: 
76: ## 9. Documentation
77: 
78: - [ ] 9.1 Add `docs/tls-client.md` — operator-facing setup guide: trust-store population, pinning, `require_pqc` flag, `require_synced_clock` flag, troubleshooting `TlsClientError::*` codes
79: - [ ] 9.2 Extend `docs/verifiable-audit-log.md` with a "TLS prerequisites" section that points operators at `docs/tls-client.md`
80: - [ ] 9.3 Update CLAUDE.md Crate Feature Flags section: `tls-client` (no feature flags in v1; transitive activation via `container::audit-export`)
81: 
82: ## 10. CI plumbing
83: 
84: - [ ] 10.1 `tls-client` added to host-testable list (workspace-wide `cargo test` auto-picks)
85: - [ ] 10.2 Fuzz Testing job extended with `fuzz_tls_record_parse`, `fuzz_tls_x509`
86: - [ ] 10.3 Coverage gate: ≥85 % line coverage on `tls-client` first pass
87: - [ ] 10.4 Pin-check job ensures `tls.trust_store_path` permissions are 0640 (defense-in-depth — operator-readable, world-unreadable)
88: 
89: ## 11. Verification
90: 
91: - [ ] 11.1 `cargo test -p smallaios-tls-client` — all unit + cross-vector tests pass
92: - [ ] 11.2 `cargo clippy -p smallaios-tls-client -- -D warnings` clean
93: - [ ] 11.3 `cargo test -p smallaios-container --features audit-export` — 30 existing audit_export_runtime tests still pass plus the new TLS-end-to-end test
94: - [ ] 11.4 `openspec validate tls-tcp-client-v1 --strict` passes
95: - [ ] 11.5 `cargo build -p smallaios-container` (no feature) still compiles cleanly — D10 Layer 1 zero-overhead-when-off invariant from `verifiable-audit-log-v1` preserved
